messages:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — ran a quick audit and found ~120 accounts marked as "Onboarded" in Salesforce with zero product events in the last 30 days. Could be a CRM sync or our playbook never fired. Posting the query I used so we can triage:
```sql
-- find onboarded accounts with no activity last 30d
SELECT a.account_id, a.owner_id, a.stage, COUNT(ev.id) AS events
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN product_events ev ON ev.account_id = a.account_id AND ev.occurred_at > now() - interval '30 days'
WHERE a.stage = 'onboarded'
GROUP BY a.account_id, a.owner_id, a.stage
HAVING COUNT(ev.id) = 0;
```
Alex Chen: Raw numbers; I sampled owners and it’s not concentrated to a single AE/team. Thoughts?

Maria G: ugh, thanks for flagging. do we exclude trial-only leads here? some trials never hit product but are expected.

Jordan R: timeline? when did stage flip to onboarded? could be old accounts flagged via CSV import last quarter.

Alex Chen: good point. query above is current-state. here's a small tweak to include stage_change_date:
```sql
-- include stage change date
SELECT a.account_id, a.owner_id, a.stage_change_date, COUNT(ev.id) AS events
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN product_events ev ON ev.account_id = a.account_id AND ev.occurred_at > now() - interval '30 days'
WHERE a.stage = 'onboarded'
GROUP BY a.account_id, a.owner_id, a.stage_change_date
HAVING COUNT(ev.id) = 0;
```
Alex Chen: Looks like ~60 of the 120 had stage_change_date < 90 days, others are older.

Samir Patel: I can add these to a temporary playbook segment and push a nudge (in-app + email) if owners haven't touched them. propose we do a soft nudge first (tone: help + resources), not an escalation.

Maria G: agree to soft nudge. we should filter out trial-only where sales expected no usage. also want to A/B test the nudge copy.

Jordan R: recommend canary 10% sample per owner, measure 14-day activation lift (DAU, key event). metric: increase in accounts with first_event within 14d. if +15% lift, rollout.

Alex Chen: proposed nudge copy (short):
"Hey {{first_name}} — noticed you didn’t get set up in the app after onboarding. Need a hand getting first workflow running? Quick link to a 5-min setup guide: https://redwood.app/onboard-help"

Maria G: love the short CTA. maybe personalize with product hint: "Try the quick template for automated reports" to increase relevance.

Samir Patel: will create a playbook run: segment = onboarded_no_events_30d_excluding_trial, canary = 10%, channels: in-app, email. tagging: csops.onboard-nudge. timeline: run next Wed 10am PT.

playbook-bot: Playbook created: /playbooks/cs/onboard-nudge-2025-03-12 (canary=10%). Next scheduled run: 2025-03-12T17:00:00Z. Owner: @Samir Patel.

Jordan R: I’ll wire up telemetry in the console to track first_event conversion and add a dashboard tile (owner-level). add alert if overall lift < 2% after 2 weeks so we can pause.

Samir Patel: noted — will include fallback rule: if owner responds "help needed", create a task in their queue. otherwise auto-close after 14d.

Alex Chen: thanks team — action items:
- Samir: create playbook and run canary next Wed (owns)
- Jordan: dashboard + alert (owns)
- Maria: provide 2 variant CTAs for A/B (owns)
- Alex: re-run the query weekly and post a short digest to #customer-success ops

Alex Chen: pinging @Maria G @Jordan R @Samir Patel — if no objections I’ll mark this as priority-low automation (not escalation) and move forward. :thumbsup:

Maria G: 👍

Jordan R: 👍
